description: Identify an object from sizes you measured (an outline, a bore, a pin, a flange) when you don't know its name; use find_geometry when you do. Each size is compared, within tolerance_mm, against the object's overall size in any order and against its exact feature sizes (bores, slots, pins, size tables). Ranked: all overall sizes matching first, then the most matching features; up to 25 results, each saying which numbers matched where. No match is not an error: widen tolerance_mm or file request_object.

category.description: Optional exact category from list_categories to narrow the search.

sizes_mm.description: One to four sizes in mm, e.g. [40, 80] for a profile, [10.5] for a bore.

tolerance_mm.description: Allowed difference per size, default 0.5. Use about 0.2 for caliper readings of machined parts, 1 for rough measurements.

name: find_by_dimensions
title: Search objects by measured size
